title: On the effect of the attention mechanism for automatic welding defects detection based on deep learning
authors: Xiaopeng Wang; Salvatore D’Avella; Zhimin Liang; Baoxin Zhang; Juntao Wu; Uwe Zscherpel; Paolo Tripicchio; Xinghua Yu
task: 焊缝缺陷/无缺陷监督二分类
data: 15,194 张平衡图像；T91 管 DWDI
